inventoryReady.invalidQuantity: Enter a valid quantity with up to four decimal places. Use a dot or comma, without grouping. Adjustment quantity must be greater than zero; counted quantity may be zero.
inventoryReady.missingReason: Enter a reason for the adjustment.
inventoryReady.invalidBatch: Select a valid batch in this branch and refresh its stock balance.
inventoryReady.inboundBlocked: Recalled or disposed batches cannot receive additional stock.
inventoryReady.countChanged: Saved count quantities changed. Reopen the count and review before reconciling.
inventoryReady.incomplete: Enter a valid counted quantity for every selected batch, including explicit zero when appropriate.
inventoryReady.notOpen: This count is no longer open. Reload its saved result.
inventoryReady.snapshotNote: The previous and projected quantities are submission snapshots. Other stock activity may change the current balance. The movement is authoritative for this adjustment.
inventoryReady.detailRetry: The accepted reference is saved. Refresh the result to load its movement and balance.
inventoryReady.branchBound: These forms belong to this branch. Saved counts and pending requests stay in their original branch when you switch. Unsent adjustment fields are reset.
inventoryReady.rejected: The request was rejected. Correct it before starting another adjustment.
inventoryReady.uncertain: The result is uncertain. Keep this request and retry the exact operation to recover its outcome.
inventoryReady.countScope: Count selected batches only. Add each batch explicitly; this does not count the whole pharmacy. Quantities are in the displayed stock unit.
inventoryReady.localDraft: Entries are saved on this device as you type. Save draft to send entered quantities to the server. Unentered selections remain on this device.
inventoryReady.addBatch: Find and add a batch to this count
inventoryReady.draftSaved: Draft saved. You can leave and resume this count.
inventoryReady.countAccepted: Count completed. Its saved result is read-only.
inventoryReady.noMovements: No correction movements: the completed quantities matched the stock at reconciliation.
inventoryReady.confirmReconcile: Review every selected batch before confirming. Reconciliation posts stock corrections once. Final differences use the current server stock at posting time and may differ if stock changes after this review.
inventoryReady.reconcileUncertain: Reconciliation may already have completed. Recover this same count; do not create another count to retry.
inventoryReady.history: Saved counts and history in this branch
inventoryReady.noCounts: No saved counts in this branch.
inventoryReady.branchConfirm: Switch branch? Saved count entries and pending operations remain in this branch. Unsent adjustment fields will be cleared. Return to this branch to resume.
